keyVerseDR: "Ask, and it shall be given you: seek, and you shall find: knock, and it shall be opened to you." (Lk 11:9)

level1.title: Teach Us to Pray
level1.story: A disciple said, "Lord, teach us to pray." Jesus taught them the Our Father. He said, "Ask, and you will receive. Seek, and you will find."
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What can you ask God for?
level1.prayer: Our Father, I love You. Amen.

level2.title: Ask, Seek, Knock
level2.story: Jesus was praying, and when He finished, a disciple said, "Lord, teach us to pray." Jesus said, "When you pray, say: Father, hallowed be Thy name. Thy kingdom come." He told of a friend who knocks at midnight asking for three loaves and keeps asking until he gets them. Jesus said, "Ask, and it shall be given you: seek, and you shall find: knock, and it shall be opened to you." How much more will the heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to those who ask Him!
level2.keyLine: Ask, and it shall be given you.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: What does each part of the Our Father mean?
Why does God want us to keep asking?
level2.prayer: Our Father, teach me to pray. Amen.

activity.title: Ask, seek, knock
activity.intro: Fill in the missing words, then sing them!
activity.text: [Ask], and it shall be given you: [seek], and you shall find: [knock], and it shall be opened.

art.mainBrief: Jesus teaching disciples the Our Father
art.heartBrief: Door to knock on in heart
